indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX "Equipment_companyId_siteId_idx" ON public."Equipment" USING btree ("companyId", "siteId")
CREATE INDEX "ServiceTicket_companyId_priority_updatedAt_id_idx" ON public."ServiceTicket" USING btree ("companyId", priority, "updatedAt" DESC, id)

scope: Owned PostgreSQL 18.6 on an internal Docker network, five fictional business rows; no hosted connection.
limits: This rehearsal does not establish the state, privileges, latency or recoverability of Neon.
Only the two indexes and Prisma migration journal change.
